ITEM 1 | Dark purple-black small drupelets clustered into a cone-shaped berry, matte with slight sheen, slightly bumpy surface, about 2 cm long, several pieces stacked in the center-upper plate, sitting on and against red berries | 75
ITEM 2 | Bright red soft-looking berry pieces with rounded bumpy surface, slightly glossy, roughly 2 cm each, about six pieces grouped in the center and lower right of the plate, adjacent to dark berries | 70
ITEM 3 | Thin orange-red smear and streaks with glossy, watery appearance across the upper left and upper right of the plate, flat with no height, a few small dots near the left edge | 8
ITEM 4 | Small pale yellow-cream crumb fleck near the right edge of the plate, about 0.5 cm, matte and crumbly | 1
